categories.title: 1. Product Discovery, Architecture & Core IAM
categories.description: Requirements freeze, UI/UX, Keycloak identity engine, Citizen Web Portal, and admin workflows over a 2-month build.

categories.title: 2. Integrations & Migration Tooling
categories.description: Adapters for Dojah (NIN/CAC), Termii (SMS), 3 initial TSPs (PayKaduna, KADVREG, PIT), and legacy migration rehearsal.

categories.title: 3. Sovereign Infrastructure & Local Tier-III Hosting
categories.description: CI/CD DevOps, Nigerian Tier-III app cluster, PostgreSQL replica, Redis, MinIO, encrypted backups, and monitoring.

categories.title: 4. Security Testing, DPIA & Edge Protection
categories.description: Automated test suites, load testing, privacy/DPIA review, and Cloudflare DNS/CDN edge shielding (zero cached PII).

categories.title: 5. Go-Live Handover & Operational Contingency
categories.description: Operator runbooks, TSP handover, part-time on-call patching, and ₦3,000,000 delivery reserve.

scenarios.name: Lean R1.0 Pilot (Recommended)
scenarios.description: 2-month build, 4 core senior engineers, Keycloak self-hosted, 3 initial TSPs, local Tier-III data residency, 30k SMS/mo, 2k KYC/mo. Target under ₦48M ceiling.

scenarios.name: Full Government Enterprise (R1.1+)
scenarios.description: State-wide production deployment across all 23 LGAs with 14 TSPs, 100,000 MAU, active-active multi-AZ cluster, and 24/7 dedicated support.

scenarios.name: High-Scale Turnkey & Surge
scenarios.description: Massive state-wide engagement with peak filing concurrency, multi-AZ cluster scaling, and 500,000 MAU.

items.title: Product discovery and solution architecture
items.description: Freeze pilot requirements, data model, threat model, acceptance criteria

items.title: UX, UI and WCAG implementation
items.description: Registration, login, consent, profile and admin flows; responsive web only

items.title: IAM and security-engine core
items.description: Keycloak integration, persona model, password policy, TOTP, sessions, token claims, risk rules

items.title: Citizen web portal
items.description: Individual NIN path, corporate CAC path, agency manual path, login/recovery, profile and sharing screens

items.title: KYC and notification adapters
items.description: Dojah adapter for /CAC, retry/provisional states, Termii adapter, email adapter

items.title: OAuth 2.0 / PKCE and TSP integration
items.description: Core IAM client plus PayKaduna, KADVREG and PIT; reusable onboarding template for later TSPs

items.title: Consent, audit and admin workflows
items.description: Four consent-event records, append-only controls, agency maker/checker queue, basic NDPA export

items.title: Pilot migration/import tooling
items.description: Staged import and matching for a limited sample; dry run and rollback

items.title: DevOps and deployment
items.description: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, backups, monitoring, TLS, logging and recovery runbook

items.title: QA, performance and security testing
items.description: Automated tests, UAT, abuse tests, load test at pilot volumes, remediation

items.title: Go-live, training and handover
items.description: Admin training, operator runbook, TSP handover, launch support

items.title: Privacy/DPIA and security review
items.description: DPIA support, privacy notices, access/retention review, independent security review

items.title: Delivery contingency
items.description: Small reserve for integration failures, provider changes and scope clarification (9.7% of pre-contingency build)

items.title: Nigerian Tier-III compute and managed connectivity
items.description: Small production cluster: app nodes, PostgreSQL primary/replica, Redis, MinIO, gateway and backups; local Tier-III quote

items.title: Backup, monitoring and log retention
items.description: Encrypted backups, off-site copy, uptime checks, alerting and limited log archive

items.title: SMS/OTP
items.description: Allowance for about 30,000 messages/month; Termii pricing is usage-based (approx ₦8/SMS)

items.title: NIN/CAC verification
items.description: Allowance for about 2,000 paid checks/month during pilot; Dojah API at ~₦100/check

items.title: Transactional email
items.description: SES or another approved provider; use email only for low-sensitivity links and notices

items.title: Domain, DNS, edge protection and certificates
items.description: Domain plus Cloudflare DNS/CDN/WAF configuration (no cached NIN/PII at edge)

items.title: Pilot operations and on-call allowance
items.description: Part-time DevOps/security response and monthly patching; excludes a 24/7 enterprise SOC
